stories.title: Witte Huis weert verslaggevers van CNN, MS NOW en Politico na verbod van Trump

en.title: White House bars reporters from CNN, MSNBC and Politico following Trump ban
en.summary: Journalists from CNN, MSNBC, and Politico were denied access to the White House today, a measure announced by President Trump the previous day. Trump cited coverage he deemed unfavorable as the reason for the action.

stories.title: CNN staat voor een dichte deur van het Witte Huis, volgens Trump produceert de zender voortdurend ‘fictie en leugens’

en.title: CNN faces closed door at White House; Trump says network produces 'fiction and lies'
en.summary: President Trump has restricted CNN's access to the White House, characterizing the network's reporting as producing false information.

stories.title: 24 aanhoudingen bij extreemrechtse betoging in Den Haag

en.title: 24 arrests at far-right protest in The Hague
en.summary: Police arrested 24 demonstrators at an extremist rally in The Hague for violations including breaching emergency orders and illegal weapon possession. Authorities banned a planned march through the city due to public disorder and confrontations.

stories.title: Noodpakket voor drie dagen? Dat is volgens Clingendael veel te weinig

en.title: Emergency package for three days? That is far too little, according to Clingendael
en.summary: A think tank assesses that a three-day emergency package is insufficient for addressing the situation at hand.

stories.title: Trump voegt daad bij het woord: Eerste journalisten geweerd uit Witte Huis

en.title: Trump follows through: First journalists barred from White House
en.summary: Journalists from CNN, MSNBC, and Politico were denied access to the White House on Saturday, following President Trump's Friday announcement that these outlets would no longer be welcome.

stories.title: NAVO verwelkomt Groenland-deal met VS, Denen benadrukken behoud soevereiniteit

en.title: NATO welcomes Greenland deal with US, Denmark emphasizes sovereignty retention
en.summary: NATO responded positively to a Greenland agreement involving the United States, Denmark, and Greenland. Denmark and Greenland stated the deal preserves Greenlandic sovereignty despite Trump's assertion that Washington would gain permanent control over the island's security.

stories.title: Denemarken en VS blijven vaag over Groenland-deal, NAVO is tevreden

en.title: Denmark and US remain vague about Greenland deal, NATO is satisfied
en.summary: The United States, Denmark, and Greenland have disclosed limited details about their agreement on Greenland, which is scheduled for signing next week. The specific terms of the arrangement remain undisclosed.

stories.title: Extreemrechtse demonstratie in Den Haag beëindigd na geweld tegen ME, 24 aanhoudingen verricht

en.title: Far-right demonstration in The Hague ended after violence against riot police, 24 arrests made
en.summary: A far-right demonstration in The Hague escalated into violence, prompting local authorities to declare an emergency order for part of the city and make 24 arrests.

stories.title: Extreemrechtse betoging op Malieveld ontbonden na geweld tegen ME, noodbevel van kracht

en.title: Far-right protest at Malieveld dissolved after violence against police, emergency order in effect
en.summary: Police intervened at a far-right demonstration in The Hague when protesters became violent and threw fireworks. The gathering was officially dissolved in the afternoon and an emergency order was implemented.

stories.title: Advies Clingendael: niet voor drie, maar voor acht dagen eten in huis

en.title: Clingendael Advice: Store Eight Days of Food, Not Three
en.summary: The Clingendael Institute recommends Dutch households increase their food stockpiles due to concerns about the nation's vulnerability in food distribution and production systems.

stories.title: Nederlanders moeten voor acht dagen eten in huis hebben in plaats van drie

en.title: Dutch people should keep eight days of food supplies instead of three
en.summary: Research from the Clingendael Institute and Erasmus University recommends Dutch households maintain eight days of food supplies, increasing from the current three-day guideline.

stories.title: CNN, Politico en MS NOW volgens Trump ‘per direct’ uit Witte Huis verbannen, maar gevolgen nog onduidelijk

en.title: CNN, Politico and MSNOW banned from White House by Trump 'immediately', but consequences unclear
en.summary: Trump announced an immediate ban on three news outlets from White House access, though further details about implementation remain unclear.
